in_marathi.name: Jaiwant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaiwant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jai (Victory) + Want (Conqueror, Desire): Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Jaya’ (Victory) and ‘Iccha’ (Desire). This name signifies a victorious or conquering person who overcomes challenges with bravery and determination.

vedic_reference.note: Jaiwant is a popular name in Hindu mythology. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jai' which means 'victory' and 'want' which means 'desire' or 'longing'. The name is often given to boys born into Hindu families as a sign of hope for a victorious and successful life.
